bagPolicy.summary: Large backpacks, suitcases, beach bags and equipment bags are prohibited. The venue does not publish a smaller bag size limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The preferred lot behind the theatre is sold first come first served as a ticket add-on; remaining spaces may be sold by the lot attendant. The lot is staffed from one hour before doors until 30 minutes after the show; street parking is also available.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ and directions do not designate a rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions are cashless, with assistance available through Guest Services. Outside food and beverages are not allowed.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: There is no need to purchase a separate accessible-seat ticket; tell security on arrival if a chair in the ADA area is needed. The venue provides alternate security screening when needed and admits service animals.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue FAQ and policies do not publish a re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Most tickets are delivered through the AXS mobile app using the purchasing email address. The show-day box office opens one hour before doors, and in-person tickets carry a $2.50 fee.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: All guests pass through walk-through metal detectors. Quick Pass has a separate general-admission entry line at the regular door time and also requires an event ticket.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
